sections.text:
The maintenance works require putting the 
turbo-generator out of operation for a long period about 3 weeks. During such 
repair, the turbine bodies are not usually opened. Only the inspection of 
selected wholes or inspection is performed, e.g.:

items: Inspect the bearings

Inspect the control of the gland steam with instrument maintenance 
 department

Inspect of the control circuit of the lubrication oil temperature by 
 instrument maintenance department
Check the function of the starting-up equipment and the removal of defects

Check the function of lifting pump or the adjustment of pressure the function 
 of oil pumps driven by electric motors and of the oil steam fan or their 
 repairs
Clean and test oil cooler of turbine.
Clean all magnetic filters of bearings of turbine.
Clean fine screen of oil tank.
Inspect and adjust the opening stroke of control valve of turbine.
Moreover all the defects found out during the operation will be removed
Purification of the oil of turbine by oil separator
Check revolution per minute for turning gear.

Check all protection of turbine shut as over speed, decrease the vacuum & 
 temperature of bearing.

Work to be Carried out
The maintenance works require putting the 
turbo-generator out of operation for a long period about 3 weeks. During such 
repair, the turbine bodies are not usually opened. Only the inspection of 
selected wholes or inspection is performed, e.g.:
Inspect the bearings
Inspect the control of the gland steam with instrument maintenance 
 department
Inspect of the control circuit of the lubrication oil temperature by 
 instrument maintenance department
Check the function of the starting-up equipment and the removal of defects
Check the function of lifting pump or the adjustment of pressure the function 
 of oil pumps driven by electric motors and of the oil steam fan or their 
 repairs
Clean and test oil cooler of turbine.
Clean all magnetic filters of bearings of turbine.
Clean fine screen of oil tank.
Inspect and adjust the opening stroke of control valve of turbine.
Moreover all the defects found out during the operation will be removed
Purification of the oil of turbine by oil separator
Check revolution per minute for turning gear.
Check all protection of turbine shut as over speed, decrease the vacuum & 
 temperature of bearing.
